LanguageData.Owl_GreenLumber.label: green lumber
LanguageData.Owl_GreenLumber.description: This lumber has been cut from logs, but has yet to be dried out in a controlled environment.
LanguageData.Owl_WoodLog.label: wood log
LanguageData.Owl_WoodLog.description: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.
LanguageData.Owl_WoodLog.tools.log.label: log
